## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does. Link the issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the relevant automated checks and manual scenarios completed, with their
results. For desktop tests, include OS build and local/remote session type.
State what remains untested. Use sanitized output and synthetic data.

## Risks and limitations

Describe relevant paste behavior, clipboard privacy, destination selection,
compatibility, dependency, or release risks. Write “None identified” if appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the code of conduct.
- [ ] The title and commits follow Conventional Commits in English.
- [ ] The change preserves native paste and conservative context handling, or explains the agreed scope change.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; validation limits are explicit.
- [ ] Any live desktop test was agreed beforehand and owned processes were closed.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Versioning remains managed by release-plz.
- [ ] No private clipboard content, personal paths, credentials, or unredacted screenshots/logs are included.
